# vendor

`meta_sam_parser` 0.1.0 is Meta's official Python parser for the SAM 3.1 segmentation protocol (PyPI `meta-sam-parser`,
no dependencies, Python 3.10 or newer). It is copied here unchanged, with its SAM License (file `meta_sam_parser/LICENSE`),
because the live server decodes the masks that Meta Model API returns. Source: https://github.com/meta-models/meta-sam
